infeasible_stated.reason: `IF WS-PSUB = WS-PTR2`: WS-PTR2 is WS-PTR plus 4 (ADD 4 TO WS-PTR2-N, 52) and WS-PSUB is ADDRESS OF LS-BODY, the 12-byte item that follows the 4-byte LS-HEAD in the view based on WS-PTR (SET ADDRESS OF LS-AREA). Both are the same address on every run; no scenario input reaches this program.
`IF WS-PSUB NOT = WS-PTR`: WS-PSUB is ADDRESS OF LS-BODY, four bytes past the base WS-PTR that LS-AREA is based on, so it is never equal to WS-PTR. The program takes no input.

`IF WS-RESP = 0` ELSE arm: the only commands it follows are GETMAIN FLENGTH(16) INITIMG and FREEMAIN DATA(LS-AREA) of the storage that GETMAIN obtained. GETMAIN raises LENGTHERR/NOSTG/INVREQ for a bad length, exhausted storage or a bad option, FREEMAIN INVREQ for storage not obtained by GETMAIN; none applies to a 16-byte request the program frees itself. The program takes no input.

infeasible_stated.reason: `IF WS-RESP = 0` ELSE arm after `RECEIVE SET(WS-PTR) LENGTH(WS-LEN) RESP(WS-RESP)` as the first command of CA0D: CA0D is a terminal transaction, started only by typing its id, so a terminal is attached and its input is the data RECEIVE reads. RECEIVE raises NOTALLOC for a task with no terminal (a START-ed task; nothing in the estate STARTs CA0D, CA0E is the started one), LENGERR only for a too-small INTO area (SET has none), INVREQ for a bad option or a second RECEIVE on a finished input, EOC / INBFMH / SIGNAL for chained or FMH data on a 3270 the transaction never sets up, and TERMERR for a device fault. No scenario input (the typed text) reaches any of them; TERMERR is a device fault, not program input.

infeasible_stated.reason: IBM CICS POST (SET): the timer-event control area is created as binary zeros, and POST AFTER SECONDS(5) with no condition (RESP NORMAL, the only answer the scenario's fixed request can get) hands its address over; 'IF LS-TEC = LOW-VALUES' false needs a non-zero area before any WAIT, which IBM never describes. Register X63.

IBM CICS POST / WAIT EVENT: once WAIT EVENT ECADDR on a POST's area returns NORMAL, the area is posted ('its first byte is set to X'40' and its third byte to X'80''), so 'IF LS-TEC(1:1) = X'40' AND LS-TEC(3:1) = X'80'' always holds; the fixed POST AFTER SECONDS(5) and WAIT give no scenario input that makes either answer a condition. Register X63.

infeasible_stated.reason: Every URL the program parses is a constant in PARSE-PARA / LENGTH-PARA (each has a path) and the only scenario input is the mode letter; the parsed PATH keeps its leading '/' (register X36, ASSUMED: IBM does not say; a URL with no path is REFUSED by the model), so 'IF WS-PATH(1:1) = '/'' is false only for a URL the program never holds.

QUERYSTRING is returned without its question mark (register X36, ASSUMED, as IBM's WEB CONVERSE takes it), and the URLs are the program's constants, so the first byte of WS-QRY is never '?' on a successful parse: the true arm ('MOVE WS-QRY(2:10)') runs for no input.
